scope: Reuse frozen rules, accepted first-five outputs and verified metadata; expand remaining domestic shards separately. No paid API, model inference, BU work, parser redevelopment or historical-text inference.
analysis_unit: One admitted canonical US advertisement. Known first-five denominator is 424226: 424225 processed and 1 invalid_text. Retain all in the coverage and metadata funnel; use only 424225 processed advertisements for wording comparisons, excluding invalid text from neither-observed and all feature denominators.
primary_contrast: Any AI wording (AI-only plus both) versus software-only wording, with all four exclusive groups also reported separately.

comparison_1.outcomes: Frozen general, occupational/task, industry/domain and tool experience wording; general/related cooccurrence; literal duration and conditional/unknown states. Related is occupational/task OR industry/domain. Categories remain non-exclusive.
comparison_1.main_strata: Validated current O*NET detailed occupation code.
comparison_1.common_support: At least 20 analyzable ads per comparison arm in an occupation.
comparison_1.standardization: Give each eligible occupation weight proportional to min(n_software_only,n_any_ai), normalized across eligible occupations; use identical weights for both arms. Report raw rates, standardized rates, percentage-point differences, cell counts and retained sample shares.
comparison_1.sensitivity: AI-only versus software-only with its own disclosed overlap population; frozen narrow versus broad wording; company-by-occupation comparison where each arm has at least 5 ads, otherwise explicitly unavailable.
comparison_1.threshold_rationale: Predeclared practical cell-size thresholds for a descriptive pilot, not a semantic-accuracy standard or causal identification strategy. No iterative threshold tuning to improve results.

comparison_2.population: General-work no-experience or graduate-eligibility wording under frozen rules. The no-experience component must match frozen explicit_no_experience flag (waiver objects exactly general_work), not every tool/industry-specific waiver. Retain separate component counts and broader junior wording.
comparison_2.outcomes: Frozen current-duty candidates for independent judgment, client responsibility, supervision/mentoring when represented by existing evidence; do not infer missing components or count prior mentoring experience as present duties.
comparison_2.interpretation: Ad-level wording cooccurrence, not proof of the same clause, unconditional eligibility, actual novice hiring or seniorization over time.
comparison_2.field_limits: Junior title versus body cannot be separated. Graduate evidence scope is not recorded. No-experience missing scope remains unknown, separate from conditional and unconditional scopes. Tool/industry waivers cannot imply zero general work experience.

quality_gates: Pin accepted input/code receipts and verify exact 424226 left-join denominator with unique canonical keys.
No-to-many joins; preserve missing/unofficial/placeholder occupation and unmapped geography categories.
Each technology partition sums to its stated denominator; rates, component unions and common-support weights reconcile.
Fail required checks on inconsistent evidence links or unexpected processing states; no silent zero filling of unknown meaning.
Cloud scheduled execution only; export public aggregates and code, not row IDs or evidence text.
claims: Conditional descriptive differences in delivered text for the admitted first-five shard population. No probability-sample, employer-adoption, historical computerization, semantic-gold or causal claim. No p-value-driven selection.
production: Inventory all frozen domestic input manifests against accepted shard receipts; process only pending admitted shards in bounded resumable batches, with capacity checks and QA gates. Preserve existing accepted outputs and report actual remaining scope.
delegation: Sol engineering for inventory/production and analysis; Luna documentation/release; root economic definitions, one-off decisions and acceptance.
